description: Every unit at one multi-unit property: a hotel, glamping site or building whose units share a booking site and a location. Search results carry readyToBook.property.id when a home is one of several such units. Returns the property (name only where the operator's own unit titles share it), and each unit with its label, bedrooms, guests, CielStay page and readyToBook. With checkIn and checkOut, each unit's readyToBook also carries availability and the total on the host's site for those dates (up to 30 units).

id.description: The property id (readyToBook.property.id from a search result).
